response.sql:
WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb,
        AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE UA IS NOT NULL
      AND UA <= 3.9
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_hgb) AS average_of_patient_avg_hgb,
    AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS average_of_patient_avg_aptt_minus_pt
FROM patient_averages;

assumptions.assumption: “Using a uric acid cutoff of 3.9” means selecting records with UA at or below 3.9.
